samples.question: The image shows three filled colored regions on a white background: one red, one green, and one blue. One region is a wide base block; the other two colored regions sit on top of the base, and each of them touches the base along a stretch of shared boundary. A pair of regions SHARES A BOUNDARY when their filled areas touch along a contiguous edge. The two regions that sit on top of the base do not touch each other; there is a clear white gap between them. Which two colored regions run along each other for the greatest distance, that is, which pair has the longest shared touching edge? Reply with exactly one of red-blue, red-green, or green-blue.
